value.text: Hi! Registration for Ada's Preschool Swim opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7:00 p.m. (Eastern). If you'd like, I'll join the open for you, waiting room and queue included. These are the sessions I saw: Preschool Swim Sat 9:00 (Jan 9, $98) and Preschool Swim Sun 10:00 (Jan 10, $98). Could you tell me which ones you want, in order of preference, and the most you're willing to pay? I'll pay only with the card already saved on your city account, and only up to your maximum. Also, may I tick the town's activity waiver at checkout? One heads-up: if you also queue on your own phone or computer, you'll hold two places in line, and the town's queue counts that as more than one place. The registration link follows this message.
